courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 計軸器列車占用偵測
related.transfer: 可遷移「轉轍力位移作功」與「鎖閉確認狀態機」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；計軸器列車占用偵測的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Point-machine force–travel work" and "State machine for lock confirmation" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Axle-counter train-occupancy detection must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦轉轍傳力鎖閉與狀態確認鏈；計軸器列車占用偵測則以計軸事件守恆方向與資料有效性為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on point-machine force transfer locking and state-confirmation chain; Axle-counter train-occupancy detection centres on axle-count event conservation direction and data validity, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「轉轍力位移作功」與「區段軸數守恆」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到計軸器列車占用偵測，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「未知占用狀態保存」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Point-machine force–travel work” and “Axle conservation within a section”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Axle-counter train-occupancy detection, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Preserving unknown occupancy states", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 列車定位與里程融合
related.transfer: 可遷移「轉轍力位移作功」與「鎖閉確認狀態機」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；列車定位與里程融合的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Point-machine force–travel work" and "State machine for lock confirmation" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Train-position and odometry fusion must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦轉轍傳力鎖閉與狀態確認鏈；列車定位與里程融合則以多感測定位的誤差相關性與完整性為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on point-machine force transfer locking and state-confirmation chain; Train-position and odometry fusion centres on error correlation and integrity in multisensor train localization, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「轉轍力位移作功」與「輪徑比例與里程」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到列車定位與里程融合，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「融合感測時基漂移」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Point-machine force–travel work” and “Wheel-scale error and odometry”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Train-position and odometry fusion, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Clock drift in sensor fusion", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 鐵路道岔轉轍機
history.text: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：2002 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法早期版發布。；2023 年歐盟列控技術規則二零二三號一六九五發布。；2025 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法第一分冊發布。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對轉轍傳力鎖閉與狀態確認鏈而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用連桿幾何與力矩及障礙與中止試驗矩陣連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。
history.textEn: The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 2002: An early railway RAMS specification was published. 2023: European Commission Regulation twenty-twenty-three slash sixteen-ninety-five was adopted. 2025: A new first part of railway RAMS was published. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For point-machine force transfer locking and state-confirmation chain, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through linkage geometry and torque and obstruction and interruption test matrix. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.
